newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai rice ends down in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai rice ends down in dull trading.

text.p: Shanghai rice futures ended down in dull trading on Tuesday with retail investors offsetting their long positions, traders said.

The November contract, the only one traded, ended at 2,312 yuan ($278) per tonne, losing eight yuan. It opened at 2,310 yuan, hitting an intra-day high of 2,315 and a low of 2,305. The settlement price was 2,323 yuan, down from 2,328.
The settlement prices are weighted average prices of all contracts transacted on the day and the limit-up and limit-down are calculated according to settlement prices.
Volume fell sharply to 700 tonnes from 8,900.
